name: CropDoc GB quick model
input: RGB photo, resized to 256 px (shorter side), centre-cropped to 224×224

training.recipe: stage 1: linear head on frozen features (full train split); stage 2: fine-tune last 3 blocks + head for ≤3 epochs on a class-balanced subset (≤300 photos/class) with standard augmentation

data.split: group-aware (photos of the same leaf never cross splits)

intended_use: General guidance for farmers and students; not a diagnosis.
limitations: Trained only on lab photos (plain backgrounds); accuracy on real field photos is lower (see Field Intelligence).
Covers only the 38 PlantVillage classes (14 crops). Other crops, e.g. apricot, are unsupported.
Quick CPU model; a stronger model from the Colab sweep replaces it only if it scores better.
